main_body: bare birch tree trunk and branches
evidence: The tree is drawn as a flat 2D side/front silhouette: a straight 4px-wide vertical column trunk (rows 15-45) and flat Y-shaped branches in one vertical plane (rows 0-15) cut off straight at row 0. Only the tiny snow puddle at the base (rows 44-47) has an elliptical footprint; the main body has no foreshortened canopy volume or 3/4 root flare.

style.evidence: Compared to the rich, organic Beodeul reference trees with 5-6 shading steps, detailed root systems, and layered 3D branches, the candidate is a stiff, straight 4px-wide vertical pole with 3 flat vertical colour stripes (off-white, light grey, mid grey) and simple block marks, plus sparse 1px stick branches chopped flat at the top edge.
